messages.content: i am back from a walk. it was nice outside.
welcome back. what did you enjoy about the walk?
the air was warm, and i saw my neighbor in her garden.
a warm walk and a little time with a neighbor can make a nice afternoon.
we did not talk. i just saw her.
okay. you saw her in the garden, but you did not stop to talk.
yes. i like seeing people around even when i want a quiet walk.
you can enjoy having people near and still want quiet time on your own.
i bought a little book of paper to write in today.
what would you like to use it for?
i want to write a little about my day.
what would you like to write in it?
a little about my day. not a long story.
you could start with one thing you did and one thing you would like to remember.
i went to the shop and saw a flower by the wall.
then you could write: i went to the shop today and saw a flower by the wall.
i share a room with my sister. i want to move the table by the window.
you could ask how she feels about moving it before you do.
give me a kind question.
would it be okay with you if we moved the table by the window?
i want to say why too. it would give me light for reading.
would it be okay if we moved the table by the window? i would like more light when i read.
what if she would like to keep it where it is?
then ask why she would like to keep it there, so you can think about both of you.
my friend is coming back to our town after being away. help me write a welcome.
welcome back. i am happy you are coming to town again. i would love to see you when you have time.
do not make it sound like she has to meet me right away.
welcome back. i hope you have a good time in town. i would love to see you when you are free.
make it shorter.
welcome back. i would love to see you when you are free.
i have a book about a bird and a book about a train. i put both in my bag.
both books are in your bag.
i gave the train book to my brother. what is left?
the book about a bird is still in your bag.
then i put it on my desk. where is the bird book now?
on your desk.
is the train book there too?
you did not say that. the last thing you said about it was that you gave it to your brother.
write a note asking my cousin to call when she gets home.
please call me when you get home, so i know you are there.
make it more like how i talk to family.
call me when you get home, okay?
add please but keep it short.
please call me when you get home, okay?
does that ask her to call before she leaves?
no. it asks her to call after she gets home.
write one sentence about a room with no window.
the room has a door and a little table, but no window.
now add a person reading. do not add a window.
a person reads at the little table in the room, which has a door but no window.
how can they read if there is no window?
the room could have a light. no window does not mean there can be no light inside.
add that light then.
a person reads by a light at the little table in the room, which has a door but no window.
i love rice, but my brother says bread is good and rice is not.
you can like rice while he would like bread. both can be good.
should i tell him he is wrong to like bread?
no. he can enjoy bread, and you can enjoy rice.
what can i say that is kind?
i like rice, and you like bread. we do not have to choose the same thing.
that is all i need.
okay.
i cleaned my room today.
how does it feel to have it done?
i waited a long time before doing it.
how does the room feel now that you have cleaned it?
calm. i can see my table again.
having the table ready to use can feel good after a long time.
i do not want to start more work now.
you can enjoy the clean room for a while.
ask my aunt if we can have lunch together. i do not know which day.
would you like to have lunch together one day? we can choose a time that works for both of us.
keep it to one question.
would you like to have lunch together one day?
now make it a question about tomorrow.
would you like to have lunch together tomorrow?
did i say she is free tomorrow?
no. that is why the sentence asks if she would like to meet. it does not say she is free.
i miss my sister, but she is at work now.
you can miss her and still wait to call when she is free. is there a thing you would like to tell her about your day?
i would like to tell her about a book i read.
you could keep the book near you or write a short note so you remember the part you want to talk about.
i do not need another thing to do. i just miss her.
okay. you can miss her and wait for a time when you can talk. we do not have to make a plan from it.
make this sentence shorter: my father is sitting on the chair that is near the kitchen door.
my father is sitting by the kitchen door.
keep the chair in it.
my father sits on a chair by the kitchen door.
make it about yesterday.
my father sat on a chair by the kitchen door yesterday.
now make it about tomorrow.
my father will sit on a chair by the kitchen door tomorrow.
i need a pen. my friend has a bag of pens. can i just take one?
ask first. you could say: could i use a pen from your bag, please?
i do not know if my friend would mind.
you can find out by asking. use only a pen they say you can have.
give me only the question to ask.
could i use a pen from your bag, please?
and if they say no?
leave their pen in the bag and ask another person, or use a pencil if you have one.
write a sentence that starts with i went to the garden.
i went to the garden and sat under the tree with my book.
did you go there?
no. that was a sentence you asked me to write, not a thing i did.
now make it about me.
you went to the garden and sat under the tree with your book.
i did not do that. it is for a story.
okay. it is a sentence for a story, not about a thing you did today.
i said i like green. what color do i like?
you like green, from what you just said.
i never said it before now.
then i know it from this part of our talk, not from before.
can i change what i like?
no. you can change what you like.
okay. i like blue now.
okay. you like blue now.
my mother spoke to my sister after she came home. who came home?
that could mean your mother or your sister. from the sentence alone, we do not know which person you mean.
ask me so you know.
who came home, your mother or your sister?
my sister. write it so we know it is her.
after my sister came home, my mother spoke to her.
can you write it starting with my mother?
my mother spoke to my sister after my sister came home.
my friend asked what i want to do tomorrow, but i do not know.
you could say: i am not sure. can i tell you later today?
make that shorter.
can i tell you later today?
now say i will know after lunch.
i am not sure now. can i tell you after lunch?
does that say i will choose after lunch for sure?
it asks to talk after lunch. if you do not know when you will be ready, ask to tell them later instead.
tell me one calm thing i can do at home. do not ask a question after it.
sit by the window with a cup of tea and take a little quiet time.
i do not like tea.
sit by the window with water and take a little quiet time.
no drink at all.
sit by the window and take a little quiet time.
now make it a shorter sentence.
sit by the window.
write about a photo of a woman by a tree. i do not know the place in it.
a woman stands by a tree in the photo.
add that i do not know where the place is.
a woman stands by a tree in the photo, but i do not know where the place is.
now use we instead of i.
a woman stands by a tree in the photo, but we do not know where the place is.
ask my brother to bring a cup, but not food.
please bring a cup. you do not need to bring food.
now make it sound more happy about seeing him.
i would love to see you. please bring a cup. you do not need to bring food.
keep just the part about the cup and food.
please bring a cup. you do not need to bring food.
does that ask for two cups?
no. here, you are only asking for one cup.
tell me to put my book away before i go to bed.
put your book away before you go to bed.
now say it with after instead of before, but keep the same order.
go to bed after you put your book away.
which thing comes first in both?
first, put your book away. then go to bed.
give that as one sentence again.
put your book away before you go to bed.
i called the house and no one answered. is no one home?
someone may be home and not near the phone. we do not know for sure from the call alone.
so there could be someone inside?
someone may be home and not near the phone. we do not know for sure.
i saw my father come through the front door just now.
then you know he came home, from what you saw.
did that make the first answer wrong?
no. the first answer was that we did not know from the call alone.
say who you are in one sentence.
hi, i am picoboi, a small model that can talk with you in this webpage.
now start with hello instead of hi.
hello, i am picoboi, a small model that can talk with you in this webpage.
now take out the model part.
hi, i am picoboi, and we can talk here.
keep only your name after hi.
hi, i am picoboi.
my friend would like me to join a game i do not know. i am not sure i will like it.
you could ask to try a short game first and then choose if you want to keep playing.
what can i say?
can we try one short game first? i would like to see how it works before i choose to keep playing.
make it just one question.
can we try one short game first so i can see how it works?
is that saying i hate the game?
no. it says you would like to try it before choosing.
a book is open on my table. does that mean someone is reading it now?
no. someone may have left it open before going to do another thing.
so the open book does not tell us for sure?
no. someone may have left it open before going to do another thing.
i left it there before making lunch.
then it was your open book on the table while you were making lunch.
yes. i came back to read after lunch.
then you left it open, made lunch, and came back to read after that.
i went to the library, got a book, met my uncle, and walked home. say that shorter.
you got a book at the library, saw your uncle, and walked home.
i met my uncle outside the shop, not at the library.
you got a book at the library, met your uncle by the shop, and walked home.
now leave out the book.
you went to the library, met your uncle by the shop, and walked home.
leave out the library too.
you met your uncle by the shop and walked home.
i have enough help with the letter now. can we talk about food instead?
yes. what kind of food would you like to talk about?
simple food for a quiet evening at home.
bread with cheese, rice with beans, or soup could all be simple things to have at home.
i just ate soup. i do not want more.
then we can leave soup out. would you like to talk about bread with cheese or rice with beans?
not the bread or rice. i just want to say the soup was good.
okay. it is nice that you had a good meal.
my brother said sorry for moving my book. it was okay. help me answer.
that is okay. thank you for telling me where you put it.
he has not said where it is.
that is okay. where did you put it?
do not make it a question. i already found it.
that is okay. i found it, and i do not mind.
make it shorter.
that is okay. i found it.
i like my family, but i want to sit alone for a while after work.
both can be true. you can care about your family and still need quiet time.
help me say it to them.
i am happy to be home with you. i need a little quiet time alone first, then i would like to talk.
i do not know when i will want to talk.
i am happy to be home with you, but i need some quiet time alone right now.
does that sound like i do not care?
no. it says what you need now, not that you do not care about them.
thank you. i have what i need now.
you are welcome.
i will try writing the note on my own.
okay. take your time.
please do not add another thing to do.
okay.
i just want to leave it there for now.
i understand.
goodbye.
goodbye.
